subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should native safety-timeout cancellation permit one explicitly marked partial compaction result to mutate and persist session state during the bounded settlement window?
rationale: Both fail-closed timeout finality and bounded partial-progress preservation are defensible product policies; automation cannot choose whether useful context retention outweighs post-timeout session mutation risk.

options.title: Accept bounded partial persistence
options.body: After repairing the sibling runtime, permit only typed partial results tied to the same safety-timeout reason to commit during the short settlement window.

options.title: Keep timeout cancellation terminal
options.body: Remove the post-timeout AgentSession acceptance path and limit the fix to clearer guidance or progress handling completed before timeout.

options.title: Require broader live proof
options.body: Pause the policy choice until a slow real provider demonstrates full-budget timeout, partial commit, restart behavior, and subsequent-turn recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded partial persistence
recommendation.body: After repairing the sibling runtime, permit only typed partial results tied to the same safety-timeout reason to commit during the short settlement window.
